title: Nirvana Scripture Soothes Wounds
summary: The Feng clan's Holy Lord apologises to Jiang Taixu because his spoiled daughter Feng Fenghuang refuses the match, and offers Ye Fan medicine, which Ye Fan says cannot heal a wound made by the Great Dao. Ye Fan tells his friends not to risk themselves hunting for cures and says he has a plan. Feng Fenghuang (Four Poles) then comes in person to reject the engagement, saying she would only marry someone who could become a Great Emperor. As the Holy Lands and the Ji family celebrate Ye Fan's coming death, killers are sent to check whether he is dead, and he kills them. He goes to bid An Miaoyi farewell, and she teaches him the Nirvana Scripture, an essence left by a disciple of the Buddha that can slow decline and heal, and combines it with a Miaoyu secret art. Neither can heal the Great Dao wound. An Miaoyi explains that the Holy Body may need the power of heaven and earth from ancient times, which survives only in the seven Life Forbidden Zones, and Ye Fan chooses to risk them rather than live on without power.
